pro.notes:
Right-click now works anywhere on the window - that is where the update-check switch lives. Failed preset saves are reported instead of being silent, damaged preset files are moved aside instead of overwritten, and presets made in the free edition are carried over. The update notice is now a card. The sound is bit-identical to 1.0.0.

How to get it: bought on pinzu.tech, use the download link in your Lemon Squeezy receipt email. Bought on BOOTH, use your BOOTH purchase history.
入手：公式サイトで購入 → Lemon Squeezy の領収書メールのリンク ／ BOOTH で購入 → BOOTH の購入履歴
